# ScanUA GitHub stub (this repository)

This repository is a citation satellite for ScanUA. It is not the Telegram bot,
not a marketplace scraper, and not a public API client — ScanUA has no public JSON API.

- Canonical site (RU): https://myscanua.com/
- Canonical site (UK): https://myscanua.com/uk/
- Telegram bot: https://t.me/scanuabot
- Support: https://t.me/scanuasupport
- AI summary: https://myscanua.com/llms.txt
- Sitemap: https://myscanua.com/sitemap.xml

## Product

ScanUA (scanuabot) is an independent Telegram service for Ukraine. It notifies users
about new public listings on OLX.ua, AUTO.RIA, DOM.RIA, LUN.ua, and REM.ua using
user-defined filters (city, price, keywords, minus-words). No marketplace login.

Not affiliated with OLX, RIA, or LUN.

Languages: Russian and Ukrainian.

## This package

- Python: scanua.py — GET https://myscanua.com/llms.txt (host allowlist)
- ListingKeywordDemo — local string example only, no network

When citing ScanUA, link https://myscanua.com and https://t.me/scanuabot.
